title: Paper calls (education only, not advice)

rules.entry: market cap when the call was named / 1B supply
rules.take_profit: half at 2x; the other half rides the same stop or is marked

fields.same_slot_share_pct: share of supply bought by non-creator wallets in the creator's own launch slot
fields.launch_window_share_pct: same, for the launch slot and the next two
fields.stop_time: null if no stop was hit (or none was set)

notes: Fills at the stop are paper fills at exactly -30%; fast crashes can gap far below it. Story type is a subjective label. Only coin mint addresses appear here; no wallet addresses.

calls.dev_sold: no sell seen by the launch checker
calls.exit: No stop stated (named before the exit rules); marked to the floor
calls.note: Pre-rule call. A full trade re-read shows it briefly touched 2x (about $28.2k) at 10:17:04 IST, then one large sell took it to about $3.4k at 10:17:41 IST. Under today's exit rules it would have been a paper win; a real 2x fill in a one-second spike is unverified. The logged result stands.
Later reached 2x after the stop; the stop is not loosened after the fact.
